 Print this Article 
 View Comments Neemias Queta will be back in the lineup for the Celtics after getting Monday night off. Kayla Wolf/AP Photo/Kayla Wolf The Celtics will kick off a four-game road trip when they take on the Nuggets in Denver Wednesday. 
 Both teams are coming off losses on Monday night. The Celtics dropped a 115-105 decision to the Magic to snap their five-game winning streak. 
 The Nuggets lost to the Suns at home, 117-105, despite getting 28 points, 15 rebounds and seven assists from center Nikola Jokic. 
 Related : It’s clear Mitchell Robinson is struggling to fit into the Celtics’ rotation, and a big test is looming The game will mark the third in four nights for the Celtics. 
 Here is a preview. 
 When: Wednesday, 9:30 p.m. 
 Where: Ball Arena, Denver 
 TV: NBCSB. Radio: WROR-FM (105.7). 
 Line: Boston -2.5. O/U: 220.5. 
 CELTICS 
 Season record: 11-3. vs. spread: 8-5, 1 push. Over/under: 6-7, 1 push 
 Last 10 games: 8-2. vs. spread: 6-3, 1 push. Over/under: 4-6 
 NUGGETS 
 Season record: 7-5. vs. spread: 5-7. Over/under: 5-7 
 Last 10 games: 6-4. vs. spread: 5-5. Over/under: 4-6 
 TEAM STATISTICS 
 Points per game: Boston 114.8, Denver 113.8 
 Points allowed per game: Boston 103.3, Denver 113.2 
 Field goal percentage: Boston .457, Denver .486 
 Opponent field goal percentage: Boston .423, Denver .462 
 3-point percentage: Boston .382, Denver .345 
 Opponent 3-point percentage: Boston .341, Denver .365 
 Stat of the day: Denver is averaging 30.9 shots from 3-point range, which is 29th in the league. 
 Notes: After getting Monday night off, Neemias Queta will be back in the lineup and draw the assignment of trying to slow down Jokic, who is nearly averaging a triple double with 24.1 points, 10.9 rebounds and 8.9 assists. The three-time MVP is playing 36.8 minutes per night. … After tonight, the Celtics will continue their road trip with games at Sacramento on Saturday and Golden State on Sunday, before returning east to wrap up the trip against the Wizards Tuesday.
